title: Millions for Housing, First-Time Homebuyer Aid
summary:
*   **Boosting First-Time Homeownership:** Approved a $145,600 grant to provide down payment assistance, aiming to help more residents become first-time homeowners in Travis County.
*   **Seeking Millions for Housing Projects:** The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) moved to apply for $23 million in Private Activity Bond Authority, a key step towards funding future affordable housing initiatives.
*   **Focus on Housing Affordability:** The meeting underscored AHFC's commitment to expanding access to housing through financial aid and securing major development funds.
transcript:
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
August 17, 1995
The meeting was called to order at 3:40 p.m. Present: Bruce Todd, Ronney Reynolds, Jackie
Goodman, Brigid Shea, Gus Garcia
Absent:
Max Nofziger, Eric Mitchell out of room
Agenda Item No. 58 (1) Approve minutes of March 23, April 27, May 18, June
29, and July 20, 1995, meetings.
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Brigid Shea's second,
approved the minutes with a 5-0-2 vote. Board Members Max Nofziger and Eric Mitchell were
out of the room.
Agenda Item No. 59 (2)
Presentation by Travis County Commissioner Sam Biscoe relative to Travis County Housing
Finance Corporation (TCHFC)
Motion
No presentation was heard. No action was taken.
Agenda Item No. 60 (3) Approve a resolution authorizing the Austin Housing Finance
Corporation (AHFC) to administer the Travis County Housing Finance Corporation HOME grant
of $145,600 awarded by the Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)
designed to provide down payment assistance to first time home buyers and direct the AHFC
Manager to negotiate and execute a mutually acceptable agreement
Motion
The Board approved this item with a 4-0-3 vote. Board Members Max Nofziger, Brigid Shea,
and Eric Mitchell were out of the room.
•
Agenda Item No. 61 (4) Approve a resolution authorizing the Manager of the Austin Housing
Finance Corporation to file an application for allocation of Private Activity Bond
Authority with the Texas Bond Review Board in the amount of $23,000,000 by August 31,
1995. Motion The Board, on Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Jackie
Goodman's second, approved this item with a 5-0-2 vote. Board Members Brigid Shea and
Eric Mitchell were out of the room.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:50 p.m.
